name: phoenix-platform
description: Phoenix Group CRM and growth platform: leads, admissions, software sales, billing and onboarding across companies.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @phoenix/api" "npm run worker:dev -w @phoenix/api" "npm run dev -w @phoenix/web"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run start -w @phoenix/api" "npm run worker -w @phoenix/api" "npm run start -w @phoenix/web"
